deploy-bot: config-only deploy queued by andrew: DPL-1791
deploy-bot: change-type=config-only scope=global components=router,shaper,batcher scheduled=2026-03-20T00:00:00Z window=60m
andrew: pushing a narrow, microburst-focused change to routing + limits. no model binary changes. goal = reduce tail microburst cost for small customers.
lina: quick summary of what exactly is changing?
andrew: routing policy: prefer-region for low-latency queues, then fallback to any-region. shaper: introduce microburst window to smooth spikes. limits: reduce per-customer qps for ephemeral tier from 60->30, keep enterprise unchanged. batching: enable adaptive batching with target 16, cap 64. timeouts: bump request_timeout 60s->70s for the shaper path.
sam: can we see the raw snippet?
andrew: yes pasted below:
```yaml
routing:
  policy: "prefer-region"
  fallback: "any-region"
shaper:
  mode: "microburst"
  window_ms: 250
limits:
  ephemeral_per_customer_qps: 60 -> 30
batching:
  adaptive: true
  target_batch_size: 16
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 60000 -> 70000
```
carla: sounds fine but we should pin model versions on the route that falls back to any-region, otherwise differing model variants could add variance. can we pin to model v2.3.1 for the fallback pool?
andrew: good call. will pin fallback routes to v2.3.1 for the rollout. main prefer-region keeps v2.3.2.
sam: rollout plan? canary percentages and observation windows?
andrew: canary: 5% for 10m, then 20% for 15m, then 100% for remainder of 60m window if no red flags. health checks: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, generation-error-rate, tail tokens per request, and cost-per-token.
carla: add a synthetic probe hitting a heavy-history prompt every minute during canary. we saw regressions in similar changes previously.
andrew: added synthetic probe. alert thresholds: p99 latency +20% or error-rate >0.5% => pause and rollback.
ops-bot: monitor-hook created: /hooks/DPL-1791-monitoring -> paging on critical alerts (pagerduty: infra-oncall).
lina: rollback plan? commands?
ops-bot: rollback command: `/deploy rollback DPL-1791 --config-only --immediate`
ops-bot: to pin routing back: `/config set routing.policy=round_robin --tag DPL-1791-rollback`
andrew: logging and traces: please watch router.trace.* and batcher.cache.hitrate. I'll be on-call during the window.
sam: can we gate by queue length? if queue length > 500 for prefer-region, we should divert to fallback early.
andrew: will add dynamic gate: prefer-region-divert-threshold=500 -> triggers fallback at 80% of queue capacity.
carla: noting commercial impact: ephemeral customers may see higher tail latency during shift; ops will communicate to CS if we need to roll back.
lina: preflight checklist: 1) infra dryrun pass 2) monitoring hooks in place 3) pin fallback model 4) PD escalation configured 5) post-mortem owner assigned
andrew: checklist done except dryrun, kicking now.
deploy-bot: dryrun completed: OK (no infra diffs). plan start=2026-03-20T00:00:00Z
ops-bot: scheduled message to #customer-impact will be posted at start+5m with canary notes.
andrew: starting canary in ~10m. will post updates here. please react with :thumbsup: if you acknowledge being on-call.
lina: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
carla: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary started: DPL-1791 stage=canary pct=5 started_at=2026-03-20T00:10:00Z
deploy-bot: canary metrics: p99=420ms (+3%), errors=0.08%
andrew: looks green so far. ramping to 20% in 10m.
deploy-bot: ramped: stage=canary pct=20 started_at=2026-03-20T00:20:00Z
deploy-bot: canary metrics: p99=490ms (+18%), errors=0.12%
carla: p99 creeping. keep eyes on synthetic probe results.
ops-bot: synthetic probe: heavy-history prompt latency=1.2s (baseline 0.9s)
andrew: acceptable for now but watching cost and tail. if probe hits >1.5s or errors>0.5% we rollback.
deploy-bot: ramping to 100% at 00:35Z
deploy-bot: deployment complete: DPL-1791 state=active started_at=2026-03-20T00:10:00Z completed_at=2026-03-20T00:35:00Z
lina: following up: please file a short release note in the release-docs repo summarizing the config-only change and the pinned fallback model.
andrew: will do. releasing a postmortem template if anything pops. thanks team.
carla: good run. keeping this open for 60m observation window.
deploy-bot: observation window end scheduled at 2026-03-20T01:35:00Z
